column1: # bootstrap-exempt.tsv -- the CLOSED list of derivations allowed a host PATH (gate2 drv-gate A1 / pkgs/illumos/path-gate.sh), until
# the bootstrap-tools wave (/scratch/solnix/wave6/BOOTSTRAP-TOOLS-DESIGN.md) gives the chain a store root. Orchestrator, 2026-11-02:
# the BOOTSTRAP SET is the seed instance and the gate/world slices. Anything else with a host PATH entry FAILS, even if it looks
# like a slice. Read by: scripts/drv-gate.sh (gate2) and `pkgs/illumos/path-gate.sh --exempt-check <drv>...` (both apply the markers).
# COMPENSATED: every exempt out needs a cross-host proof (chef = OpenIndiana with /usr/gnu, dixi = solnix without it, same NarHash),
# recorded per drv in wave6's HANDOFF. One that differs is fixed, not exempted. aarch64 has one host (dixa), so its rows' proof is
# same-host (nix-store --check in a second build dir, as for its served rows), named in the row's why; no cross-host proof exists.
# A drv is exempt iff its env `name` matches the name regex (anchored) AND the marker holds:
#   seed     : env btPath is present and empty (mk-src-pkg's seed instance, buildTools = [ ]; the system instance's same-named
#              recipes have btPath set, so a name match alone would exempt them: gate2 step5)
#   gccseed  : env stage0 = /usr/gcc/14 (gcc-src.nix compiled by the OI IPS seed)
#   slice    : env gate (the proto) and filesArg (mk-illumos-component: libc, ld, rtld, sys, base-tools)
#   pslice   : a mk-proto-slice carve (illumos-early, -zfs, -halt, -core-utils, -oamuser, -smf), measured on their drvs: builder
#              /usr/bin/bash, env PATH exactly /usr/gnu/bin:/usr/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin, env keys exactly mk-proto-slice's (gate binsArg
#              depsArg ... no filesArg, no CC/btPath), and every input drv is the gate proto's, a slice/pslice, or a system-instance
#              recipe its depsArg names (zlib, libxml2: the SMF stack's libxml2.so.16/libz.so.1 edges; judged as themselves)
#   libcx    : env keys exactly builder gate libc name out system (base-src's illumos-libc-extra: 2 gate libs copied + elfedit; an
#              input of the seed gcc14, so it stays as it is until the bootstrap-tools wave; gate2 drv-gate found it, wave6t step3)
#   world    : env gate and dirsArg and sharedLibsArg (mk-proto-world: illumos-userland, its -dev output, and the world man)
#   fod      : a fixed-output drv (outputHashMode recursive, a full sha256 outputHash): the pinned hash fixes its bytes whatever
#              tools ran (NixOS fetchers also run outside the sandbox); gate2 A4 checks the hash is real
#   seedenv  : buildEnv/alias of the seed farm: env paths (or gnutar) name only outs of seed / gccseed / seedenv drvs
#   a64seed  : the frozen aarch64 seed's mk-src-pkg drvs (pkgs/illumos/aarch64/seed-main, a fixed bootstrap as nixpkgs' bootstrap-tools):
#              drv system and env system aarch64-solaris, builder /usr/bin/bash, env keys exactly its 22 (x86's seed drvs have 26),
#              btPath "", stage0 /usr/gcc/14. x86's seed instance builds cmake/ncurses/readline too, but they are in no x86 closure
#              (x86 builds take the system instance's), so they are not under `seed`; aarch64's store-only set takes the seed's as tools
#   a64glibs : the frozen aarch64 seed's mkGateLibs (gate libraries copied from the proto, RUNPATH -> itself + libc slice + zlib):
#              aarch64-solaris, builder /usr/bin/bash, env keys exactly builder gate libc name out roots system zlib, no inputSrcs,
#              and exactly 3 input drvs, each the out its env key names: the pinned aarch64 gate proto (fod), the libc slice, the
#              a64seed zlib
# name-regex
^(bash|binutils|bzip2-bin|coreutils|diffutils|findutils|gnugrep|gnum4|gnumake|gnupatch|gnused|gnutar|gzip|libxml2|nspr|nss|openssl|perl|pkgconf|xz|zlib)-[0-9][0-9.a-z]*$
